title: Estimating Uncertain Spatial Relationships in Robotics
abstract: arXiv:1304.3111v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this paper, we describe a representation for spatial information, called the stochastic map, and associated procedures for building it, reading information from it, and revising it incrementally as new information is obtained. The map contains the estimates of relationships among objects in the map, and their uncertainties, given all the available information. The procedures provide a general solution to the problem of estimating uncertain relative spatial relationships. The estimates are probabilistic in nature, an advance over the previous, very conservative, worst-case approaches to the problem. Finally, the procedures are developed in the context of state-estimation and filtering theory, which provides a solid basis for numerous extensions.

translated_title: 机器人学中不确定空间关系的估计
translated_abstract: 本文描述了一种称为随机地图（stochastic map）的空间信息表示方法，以及用于构建该地图、从中读取信息、并在获得新信息时对其进行增量修订的相关程序。该地图基于所有可用信息，包含了地图中各对象之间关系的估计及其不确定性。这些程序为估计不确定的相对空间关系问题提供了一个通用解决方案。这些估计本质上是概率性的，相比之前非常保守的最坏情况方法是一个重大进步。最后，这些程序是在状态估计和滤波理论的框架下开发的，这为众多扩展应用提供了坚实的基础。
tldr: 该论文提出了“随机地图”这一空间信息表示方法，通过概率性估计取代保守的最坏情况方法，并基于状态估计与滤波理论实现了增量更新程序，为机器人学中不确定空间关系的估计提供了通用解决方案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "stochastic map," a probabilistic representation of spatial information with incremental update procedures based on state-estimation and filtering theory, providing a general solution for estimating uncertain spatial relationships in robotics.
